title: Protect My Redstone
description: A singleplayer mod that detects active redstone ticks in loaded chunks and warns you before you log out to avoid breaking your farms/flying machines.
body:
Protect My Redstone warns you before logging out of a singleplayer world while your farms are still running. Instead of accidentally breaking a farm or stopping your flying machines by closing the game, you'll get a warning screen showing which chunks have active redstone, allowing you to turn them off.

Features:

* Detects active redstone in every loaded chunk, including chunks kept loaded by chunk loaders thousands of blocks away.
  
* Warning screen lists the top active chunk coordinates so you 
  know where your farms are running.

* Configurable countdown timer before the Leave World button   
  unlocks.

* Configurable detection threshold so you can ignore small 
  amounts of ambient redstone

* Per-component toggles to choose exactly what counts toward the 
  total:

**Mod Currently Detects:**
Moving pistons,
* Powered comparators
* Powered repeaters
* Powered observers
* Active powered rails
* Detector rails with a minecart on them
* Active sculk sensors and calibrated sculk sensors

* **All settings are configurable in-game via ModMenu**
